description: Historical DR events used to estimate future reported capacity. Each record stores the controller bid and the realized delivery against a no-DR counterfactual baseline.
recommended_use: Use this for capacity reporting / bid calibration. Keep no-DR counterfactual settlement separate for benchmark evaluation.

rerun_history.investigation_note: Root cause: user_pref_scorer.py hard-caps event_score to <=2 whenever any appliance target_reached=False (here: EV SOC target); this scoring component is unrelated to capacity delivery. Verified no_dr_baseline_kwh/actual_kwh/delivery_ratio_vs_no_dr/capacity_committable_kw are all within normal range (comparable to or better than several passing/replaced records). Verified _similarity()/estimate_event_capacity_from_memory() in dr_event_memory.py do not read event_score for ranking or output computation -- only data_quality_excluded gates retrieval eligibility. Decision: kept in RAG pool unchanged, no data_quality_excluded flag set.
